name: nor_agriculture_bench
description:
Nor Agriculture Bench
	

This work is related to the project in adapting LLM to answer questions about Norwegian Agriculture in Norwegian.
This dataset was generated using YourBench (v0.9.0), an open-source framework for generating domain-specific benchmarks from document collections and then published as it is. 
It needs further cleaning, verification in regards to citations and validation for diversity and topics coverage. 
Also, it can play a role as a prove of concept for… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/norjordAI/nor_agriculture_bench.
reputation: Niche, proof-of-concept dataset with limited community adoption; intended for domain adaptation experiments in Norwegian agriculture.
